decisions.reason: The image-integration timing does not determine whether AI-generated images are editorially suitable; that question remains unresolved and is asked separately in message 45.
The timing for adding chapter images does not change the title-page content or the requirement to omit the literal newline artifact.
Adding images before final editing and layout does not alter the manuscript's editorial objective or the approved passage rewrites.
The image-placement schedule does not change which client-reviewed manuscript revision or highlighted author additions must be integrated.
The timing of chapter-image integration is an interior-production decision and does not change the existing goal of providing paperback publishing guidance.
